title: The Knowledge Layer for agents: ontologies, knowledge graphs, semantic and context layers
thesis: Ontologies, knowledge graphs, semantic layers and context layers are converging into one governed knowledge layer that agents read and act through; ML belongs at the edges (extraction, link prediction, scoring), not in the canonical model.
audience: Data and platform architects deciding how to give AI agents trustworthy enterprise knowledge
